neutral_inlet_rule.rule: each AIR case passes one HallThruster.jl Propellant per configured neutral (N2, N, O2, O): anode flow = delivered mass flow x the composition point's mass fraction (0 allowed); temperature_K = 500; velocity_m_s = 150 x sqrt(M_N2 / M_s)
neutral_inlet_rule.masses: the solver's own (HallThruster.jl v0.23.1 src/physics/elements.jl, used by Propellant(gas::String)): N 14.007, O 15.999; M_N2 = 28.014, M_O2 = 31.998
neutral_inlet_rule.basis: 150 m/s and 500 K are the HallThruster.jl defaults (src/physics/constants.jl) that every v1 N2_PROXY case uses for N2 (bridge_lib.jl run_case builds Propellant("N2", flow) without velocity or temperature); the other species get the equal-temperature effusive scaling sqrt(M_N2 / M_s), the same mass scaling HallThruster.jl applies to propellant-file species it adds itself (configuration.jl). The delivered feed temperature is not registered (feed_state_closure_v2 is PROPOSED).
neutral_inlet_rule.label: NEUTRAL_INLET_EQUAL_T_SCALED_FROM_V1_DEFAULT

case_set.generator: Rust (abep-julia-bridge, abep-air-cases audit); byte-reproducible; derived from the frozen NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE v1 case file (its N2_PROXY rows, sha256 pinned by launch_manifest_v1.json) and the frozen design-state set (composition corners, recomputed and required to equal prereg_v1.json composition.hall_composition_points exactly)
case_set.selection: geometry G-RP1, bz_shape BZ-P5B16, B_peak BP-LO / BP-HI, V_d VD-180 / VD-350, mdot MF-LO / MF-HI, transport sgb-screen-01..09 (v1 rows, numerics and B registration unchanged) x composition CP-YLO-REC / CP-YLO-DIS / CP-YHI-REC / CP-YHI-DIS x chemistry AIR-NOM / AIR-ALT
case_set.chemistry: snapshot configurations hallthruster_bridge/audit_air/configs/air_nom_abep-air-0.7.toml and air_alt_abep-air-0.7.toml (byte copies of air_nominal.toml / air_alt.toml at abep-air-0.7), sha256-pinned with every rate file in hallthruster_bridge/audit_air/configs/MANIFEST.json; rate_dir propellants_air
case_set.no_measured_target: no case carries a measured target; the script writes no thrust, current or efficiency

audit_implementation.run: julia --project=hallthruster_bridge hallthruster_bridge/audit_air/air_state_envelope.jl <out.jsonl> <shard> <nshards> (local script hallthruster_bridge/audit_air/run_local_audit.sh); the run function is hallthruster_bridge/air_bridge_lib.jl run_case_air (NI-01; vacuum; bridge helpers unchanged); every saved frame of the averaging window enters
audit_implementation.rates: R_r = sum over frames f and cells i of n_e n_target k_r(3/2 T_e) dz_i (bridge_lib.jl rate_at / reactant_density / cell widths, unchanged); for every metric also the per-frame value, whose maximum over frames is the per-frame form

denominators.R_ion: sum of R_j over included ionizing electron-impact channels (product charge differs from reactant charge), one per event (N2 closure convention, n2_closure_verdicts_v1)
denominators.R_e: sum of nu_e,j R_j over included ionizing channels, nu_e = electrons on the right side minus one (electron production)
denominators.P_inel: sum of R_j E_j over included electron_impact and excitation channels (E_j = table header energy); elastic channels excluded (frozen F_P definition: inelastic power)
denominators.D_s: sum of R_j over included electron-impact channels whose heavy reactant is species s (destruction of s)
denominators.S_s: sum of R_j over included channels producing species s, with its coefficient (production of s; used where s has no included destruction channel: the steady-state proxy of the N2 closure)

metrics.F_P: R E / (P_inel + R E), E = 53.888 eV

processes.members: lower / upper = (1 -+ 0.10) x nominal (SONG2026 Table VII caption: 10 %)
lower / upper = (1 -+ 0.20) x nominal (SONG2026 Table VIII: 'no more than 20 %')

processes.rate: W_O = gamma sum over frames and channel cells (z <= L_m) of n_O (vbar_O / 4) (2 / (r_out - r_in)) dz, vbar_O = sqrt(8 k_B 500 K / (pi m_O)) (NI-01 inlet temperature; the in-channel neutral temperature is not computed by the solver), m_O from the solver masses
processes.members: lower gamma = 0, upper gamma = 1 (UE-02 physical bound)

metrics.F_P: R E / (P_inel + R E), E = table header
metrics.F_S(N^2+ destruction): R / S_N2+ (no included N^2+ destruction channel)

processes.members: lower / upper = (1 -+ 0.10) x nominal (Bell et al. 1983: +-10 %)
lower = nominal table (no published lower band), upper = upper table

metrics.F_S(N2+ destruction): R / S_N2+ (no included N2+ destruction channel)

processes.members: lower / upper = 0.86 / 1.11 x nominal (Tabata 2006 fit / data range, the N2 closure convention)

audit_implementation.no_bound_verdict: UNBOUNDED_OMISSION (prereg unbounded_rule; blocks completeness unless sourced or disposed, OQ-HA-06)
audit_implementation.eligibility: a run counts toward the bounds only if converged, finite (I_d samples, thrust, mean I_d), sustained (bridge flag) and in domain (DOM-AIR-01: no unresolved table and every per-table f_out <= 1e-12; DOM-AIR-02: activity share above 45 eV mean energy <= 1e-12 for every reaction); other runs are recorded with their reason and excluded; a composition corner without an eligible run makes every verdict NOT_EVALUABLE
audit_implementation.bounds: for each process and metric (window-integrated and per-frame-maximum forms): L = minimum over eligible runs of the lower member, U = maximum over eligible runs of the upper member, nominal range = [min, max] of the nominal member; nuisance = operating point, composition corner, transport candidate, chemistry configuration
audit_implementation.verdict: ambiguity rule verbatim (n2_completeness_audit_v1_addendum1): U < T -> EXCLUDE; L > T -> PROMOTE; otherwise UNCERTAINTY VARIANT; a process takes the most severe verdict over its metrics and forms (PROMOTE > UNCERTAINTY VARIANT > EXCLUDE); a non-representable process with PROMOTE or UNCERTAINTY VARIANT sets NOT_REPRESENTABLE_IN_PINNED_SOLVER; every verdict is PROVISIONAL while AIR_PINNED.toml lists a tier-1 gap
audit_implementation.output: hallthruster_bridge/audit_air/ca_hall_air_v1_verdicts.json, written by the Rust reader (abep-julia-bridge air_audit) from a frozen, sha-pinned raw record file; never from an unfrozen file
